item.title: 👤 Finance Manager 📍 Remote 💼 YZi Labs About the Role We are looking for a Financ
item.description:
👤 Finance Manager
📍 Remote
💼 YZi Labs

About the Role
We are looking for a Finance Senior Associate / Finance Manager to support our finance leadership across accounting, financial operations, investment analysis, and portfolio monitoring.
This role involves managing financial records across international entities (SPVs and HoldCos), overseeing fiat and digital asset transactions, supporting investment accounting, and monitoring the financial performance of portfolio companies.
The ideal candidate has experience in audit, accounting, venture capital, private equity, or fund operations and can independently manage financial processes in a fast-paced, international environment.

Key Responsibilities
1. Accounting & Financial Reporting
Maintain accounting records across group entities, including journal entries, accruals, and reconciliations.
Manage monthly and quarterly financial close processes, including bank, wallet, custodian, and intercompany reconciliations.
2. Finance Operations & Controls
Review invoices, payments, and expense claims in accordance with internal approval procedures.
Support investment closings, funding arrangements, and transaction documentation.
3. Financial Analysis & Portfolio Monitoring
Analyse investment performance, returns, valuations, and portfolio exposure.
Support investment reviews, including dilution analysis, exit scenarios, and token performance.

Requirements

4–10 years of experience in accounting, audit, fund operations, investment operations, or transaction services.
Degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field; ACCA, CPA, or equivalent qualification preferred.
Strong understanding of IFRS or US GAAP and investment accounting.
Knowledge of VC/PE instruments, including preferred shares, SAFEs, convertible notes, and cap tables.
Experience with financial reporting, month-end closing, reconciliations, and external audits.
Advanced Excel / Google Sheets skills.
Familiarity with crypto wallets, exchanges, blockchain explorers, and on-chain transactions.
Comfortable using AI tools to improve financial workflows and automate tasks.
Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to work independently.
Good written and spoken English.

Preferred Qualifications

Big 4 or investment fund audit experience.
Background in venture capital, private equity, family offices, or fund administration.
Experience with digital asset accounting, crypto custody, or token operations.
Familiarity with international holding structures and SPV management.
Knowledge of Xero, NetSuite, Carta, SQL, Python, or Dune.
Experience using AI agents and automation tools such as Claude or Codex.

📞 Contact: @yunayuyyu
